description: Normalise supplier quotes to one comparable unit price (currency, unit of measure, tax, discount) — Converts up to 200 quoted prices to a net price per base unit in one currency, for an agent comparing supplier quotes. Each line: price for `per` units of a unit of measure, optional tax-inclusive flag and rate, optional percentage discount, any currency. Uses only the caller's exchange rates and unit factors (1 uom = factor base units); a currency without a rate, a unit without a factor, or a tax

baseUom.description: Name of the base unit prices are normalised to (default "unit").

rate.description: Target-currency units per one unit of `from`.

discountPercent.description: Percent discount off the net price.

per.description: Quantity the price covers (default 1), e.g. "1000" for a per-thousand price.

price.description: Quoted price in major units of `currency`, for `per` units of `uom`.

taxIncluded.description: True if the price already includes tax; then taxRate is required.

uom.description: Unit of measure of `per`; the base unit when omitted.

name: quote-normalize
